name: Chimbote

queries.query: Chimbote Peru official cadastral parcel map geospatial GIS municipal parcel service
queries.result: Found official Peru sources for the national GeoPeru/IDEP map catalogue, the SUNARP Visor de la Base Gráfica Registral (BGR), and an official MEF 2024 Chimbote urban-land-value cadastral plan. The SUNARP viewer is a parcel-capable first-party service, but public access requires DNI, date of issue, and CAPTCHA; no anonymous parcel response was obtained.

queries.query: catastro Chimbote visor predios Municipalidad Provincial del Santa
queries.result: Found first-party Municipalidad Provincial del Santa evidence of municipal cadastral custody and cadastral-information procedures, plus an official COFOPRI agreement granting the municipality restricted access to Catastro Virtual for the province of Santa. No public municipal parcel viewer or anonymous parcel feature response was verified.

registryBasis: A first-party Municipalidad Provincial del Santa organizational report identifies Sub Gerencia de Catastro and Sub Gerencia de Catastro under urban development, and a first-party COFOPRI–Municipalidad Provincial del Santa agreement documents restricted municipal access to Catastro Virtual for the province of Santa. This establishes a local municipal/COFOPRI cadastral custodian, not an openly accessible parcel API or proof of citywide completeness.

officialSources.observation: Official SUNARP service page. States that BGR displays registered-property polygons nationally and requires DNI, date of issue, and CAPTCHA; searches can use location, partida, or coordinates.
First-party SUNARP BGR viewer host. Anonymous GET timed out during this attempt; no login, CAPTCHA, credential, or bypass was attempted.
Official government-hosted COFOPRI agreement; documents restricted municipal access to Catastro Virtual for the province of Santa and records queries through Geo Llaqta.
Official Municipalidad Provincial del Santa report; identifies municipal cadastral subgerencias.
Official municipal accountability PDF; lists the municipal Certificado de Información Catastral and cadastral-plan validation procedures.
Official MEF PDF containing the 2024 Chimbote urban-land-value cadastral plan; identifies UTM zone 17, WGS84, and states the plan is referential and not a title.
